rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Are you all leaving already, mo?
Morimori is very worried about the
future of this city, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Lately it's nothing but gloomy talk
about evacuation and escape, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0003
rows.name: But the most serious problem is...!

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0004
rows.name:
At this rate, Morimori is going to run
out of food, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0005
rows.name:
The owner here says he's evacuating
too. Morimori refuses to go without
Iiran cooking, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0006
rows.name:
Everyone, please, please defeat
Heaven's Holy Grail and protect
Morimori's food and this city, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_04_msg0007
rows.name:
Then in this peaceful city, eat a meal
with Morimori, mo! Promise, mo!
